s: Din tzoa yebesha ubo b' seipim: tzoa apillu yebesha kacheres veen bah reach kelal — asur liqrot kenegdah min hattora. Vaapillu yebesha kol kak sheim yizreqenna nipreket — yesh lehistappeq veleesor, shessapeq shel tora lehachamir ad sheyyitparek al yede gelila sheyyoter beqal nipreket al yede zeriqa meal yede gelila abal keshehi nipreket al yede gelila azay hi keapar umuttar liqrot kenegdah ap al pi shello nitporka adayin abal im tishshaber lishnayim al yede gelila en zeh moil ubizman haqqor shehatztzoa niqreshet harbeh kaeben yesh lehistappeq im moil liqrot kenegdah ki shemma ap al pi shenniqreshet adayin shem tzoa aleha veasur min hattora kemo bet hakkisse sheen bo tzoa sheasur mippene sheadayin shemo alayv kemo sheyyitbaer besiman p"g vekol shekken zo sheyyekola lachazor leqadmutah al yede chom vesapeq shel tora lehachamir:

Me raglayim shennibleu baqqarqa im hem martibin hayyad shennogaat bahen asur liqrot kenegdan veyesh omerim sheeno asur ella bettopeach al menat lehatpiach kegon sheim manniach yado alehem taaleh bah lachut sheim yannichenna al dabar acher yeqabbel mimmenna lachut veim en lachut kol kak muttar veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim:
